input.query: Prepare a 10-minute presentation outline about Workflow Template and Multi-Agent Workflow Builder MVP.

topics.title: Multi-Agent Workflow Builder
points: A workflow builder turns a domain process into ordered nodes with defined inputs and outputs.
The MVP generates executable Workflow JSON and uses sequential execution and trace output to make the result explainable.
slide_suggestions: Show Template -> Workflow JSON -> Engine -> Trace.
Keep the demo under two minutes.

topics.title: Workflow Template
points: A template defines node order, node roles and required fields.
The generated Workflow JSON is the contract between the builder and the execution engine.
slide_suggestions: Use trace as proof that the template is executable.
